name: g46_roar_suction_drag_in
purpose: Roar on a Suction Cups holder, the drag-in DragOut blocker (dragIn, sim/battle-actions.ts:163-169): Gyarados Roars Malamar (Suction Cups, its only legal ability) in the active slot. The drag draws a reserve first (getRandomSwitchable), then the DragOut is blocked by Suction Cups ([-activate] ability: Suction Cups, no -fail); Malamar stays and no reserve comes in.
